patch_description: Reorganizes planning into a candidate-based broadcast architecture. Small terminal sets use an exact directed-Steiner dynamic program, while larger sets evaluate several hybrid plans: exact trees for strategically selected core destinations followed by zero-marginal-cost attachment of remaining destinations. The planner additionally compares multiple greedy attachment orders and prunes redundant links before materializing shared partition paths. This preserves the legacy topology output while improving scalable shared-transfer planning.
